session.title: CSSS scholarship — what must be verified for AY 2026–27?
session.question: What should a student verify before relying on the Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships (CSSS) information for AY 2026–27?
session.context: Two official documents were supplied: the MHRD/Department of Higher Education scheme guidelines and the Department of Higher Education CSSS FAQ. The question is not what the scheme says in general, but which details these documents actually establish for AY 2026–27 and which must be confirmed with the ministry, the institute or the state nodal agency before an application is made.
